review_candidates.title: De Rijksoverheid zoekt: Werkplekbeheer Buitendienst Zuid-Holland
review_candidates.description: Op deze pagina: Dit ga je doen Dit krijg je Dit bieden we nog meer Dit vragen wij Hier kom je te werken Bijzonderheden Over de functiegroep Stel gerust je vraag Dit ga je doen De Justitiële ICT Organisatie (JIO) een grote ICT-leverancier binnen de Rijksoverheid is op zoek naar een Medewerker Werkplekbeheer binnen het team Onsite Service Support (OSS) Buitendienst. Vanuit jouw rol zorg je ervoor dat medewerkers van onze opdrachtgevers in Zuid-Holland en de omliggende regio’s optimaal gebruik kunnen maken van hun ICT-middelen. ICT is onmisbaar voor het dagelijks functioneren van de Rijksoverheid. Als Medewerker Werkplekbeheer ben jij het aanspreekpunt op locatie en zorg je voor professionele gebruikersondersteuning. Je installeert, beheert en ondersteunt werkplekken, lost incidenten op en draagt bij aan een betrouwbare ICT-omgeving voor onze opdrachtgevers. Je werkt voornamelijk op locaties in Zuid-Holland en Zuidwest-Nederland. Daarom zoeken wij iemand die woonachtig is in deze regio en het leuk vindt om onderweg te zijn. Vanuit jouw standplaats bezoek je verschillende locaties van onze opdrachtgevers, waarbij je samen met collega’s van de buitendienst verantwoordelijk bent voor een breed scala aan ICT-werkzaamheden. Daarnaast kan het voorkomen dat je collega’s ondersteunt op andere locaties in Nederland, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is. Een leuke en dynamische functie met veel afwisseling, dat is wat jouw werk zo leuk maakt. Zo kom je bijvoorbeeld in gevangenissen, kantoorgebouwen van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming en locaties van de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek. Daar waar je komt ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de gebruikersondersteuning. Dat houdt in dat je geregistreerde incidenten oplost en dat je ICT-middelen gebruiksklaar levert, installeert, verplaatst of verwijdert. Hierbij ondersteun je ook actief bij de inrichting en uitrol van moderne werkplekken en aanlandwerkplekken. Hoewel je veel op pad bent, heb je ook nauw contact met je collega’s. Je maakt deel uit van het team Onsite Service Support (OSS) Buitendienst. De opdrachten komen binnen bij onze centrale servicedesk. Een planner plant de opdrachten in en wijst ze toe aan jou of aan een van jouw collega’s. Hierbij wordt rekening gehouden met oplostijden, levertijden en een efficiënte rittenplanning. Zo kun jij de beste service leveren aan al onze opdrachtgevers. Ons hoofdkantoor is momenteel gevestigd in Gouda, maar medio 2027 verhuizen we naar Utrecht, direct achter Utrecht Centraal. Deze verhuizing biedt nieuwe kansen om onze samenwerking te versterken en innovatie te stimuleren. Bovendien komen we daarmee centraal in Nederland te liggen, wat onze bereikbaarheid voor zowel opdrachtgevers als collega’s verder vergroot. Dit krijg je Schaal 7 €3.097 - €3.984 (bruto) Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd Vaste dienst voorafgegaan door een jaarcontract 36 uur Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur. Dit bieden we nog meer Naast het salaris ontvang je een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaalvriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je ov-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof. Daarnaast is er binnen de Justitiële ICT Organisatie een activiteitencommissie en zijn er werkgroepen op het gebied van “Vitaliteit” en “Werkgeluk” actief. Deze organiseren diverse activiteiten voor haar medewerkers om actief en energiek te blijven en verbinding te houden. Dit vragen wij Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring. Woonachtig in (of in de directe omgeving van) de regio Zuidwest-Nederland. Bezit van mbo-ICT is een pre. Kennis van TOPdesk is een pre. Certificaat ITILF of bereid zijn deze te behalen. Kennis van MS-Intune, AZ-900, MS-900 of andere relevante kennis van cloudservices. In het bezit van een B-rijbewijs. Kennis van Netwerktechnieken, voor het patchen van hardware en het vervangen van netwerkcomponenten in samenwerking met netwerkbeheer. Hardwareproducten o.a. van Apple (MacBook, iPhone, iPad), laptops, VoIP, videoconferencing, DECT, etc. Kantoorautomatisering, plaatsen van aanlandwerkplekken, replicatoren of thin clients in combinatie met monitoren, diverse printers, scanners, etc. Hier kom je te werken Over Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, Justitiële ICT Organisatie (JIO) Over de Justitiële ICT Organisatie Wij zijn de Justitiële ICT Organisatie: ICT’ers die het justitieveld door en door kennen. review_candidates.description: Overview Our affiliate, UWH of the Carolinas, is seeking a Certified Nurse Midwife to join their prestigious Women's Health Care Center in Columbia, SC.. This position is ideal for a nurse midwife who thrives in a hospital environment, values collaborative care, and is committed to providing safe, patient-centered support throughout labor, delivery, and the postpartum period. This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to join an excellent and growing practice working with a great hospital system. Looking for an experienced certified nurse midwife who wants to focus their career on performing deliveries in a hospital focused position. About Practice: Join a compassionate group who provide a team approach to patient care. Every member of our staff is focused on making the patient experience individualized and meaningful. This group of providers has been serving the Columbia metro area for 20 years with a solid reputation for top notch clinical care. * Team Structure: The practice consists of 11 OB/GYN generalist physicians, 15 laborist physicians, and 7 advanced practice providers * Hospital: Medical University of South Carolina Northeast Campus Hospital in Columbia. * Support: Strong administrative staff, nurse, and medical assistants Position Highlights: * Estimated Deliveries per Month: 10-20 deliveries * Schedule: Midwife schedule will generally be Monday-Thursday from 7am-330pm * Call Schedule: This position does not require call, nights, weekends or holidays shifts. * Provide coverage on Labor & Delivery unit and perform deliveries while practice physicians are in OR. * Perform obstetric triage and respond to urgent maternal concerns. * Collaborate closely with OB/GYN physicians, nursing staff, and hospital personnel. * Document patient care in compliance with clinical and regulatory standards. * Collaborate closely with other OB/GYN providers, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals when delivering care. * Support continuity of care for established practice patients. * Follow all practice protocols, hospital policies, and applicable professional standards. Compensation/Benefits Highlights: * Competitive compensation (negotiable hourly rate, $65-$70 an hour) * Paid time off * CME reimbursement annually * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision * 401k with matching * Company paid malpractice coverage Requirements: * AMCB Certified Nurse-Midwife * Graduate of a nurse-midwifery education program accredited by ACNM Accreditation Commission for Midwifery Education (ACME) * Master's degree in Nursing (MS/MSN) * Active and unrestricted state registered nurse (RN) license * CPR and NALS Certification * Current Unrestricted DEA License or ability to obtain * One year or more of full-time experience as certified nurse midwife is required * Labor & Delivery experience preferred City/Location Highlights: * Southern charm meets sophistication in Columbia. This South Carolina city is known for its arts scene, educational opportunities and rich history, making it a hub of culture and education. Residents can enjoy an affordable cost of living, great job opportunities and scenic riverside parks. * As the state capital and home to the state's flagship university and Fort Jackson military base, the city is a bustling economic engine for South Carolina. * Take in the natural beauty with a walk along the Riverfront Park and Historic Columbia Canal or paddle down one of the city's scenic rivers. Nature lovers shouldn't miss nearby Congaree National Park, where towering trees and wildlife await just a short drive from downtown. Families can enjoy a full day at Riverbanks Zoo & Garden, and art lovers will appreciate the Columbia Museum of Art. Whether you're watching a University of South Carolina Gamecocks football game at Williams-Brice Stadium, strolling through the South Carolina State House grounds, or catching a performance at the Koger Center for the Arts, Columbia is always buzzing with activity. This position offers a competitive salary and an excellent benefits package that includes health/dental/life/STD/LTD/vision insurance, malpractice insurance, paid time off and a 401(k) plan. Our medical affiliate is a drug-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. About Unified Women's Healthcare, LLC: Unified Women's Healthcare, LLC proudly provides physician recruiting services for the largest, physician-owned Ob-Gyn practice network in the nation, with more than 600 affiliated practices and 2,600 providers in 19 states and Washington DC. Choose an opportunity from dozens of cities; urban to rural. The national footprint of our medical affiliates provides candidates with a variety of practice settings and career opportunities that will fit their professional practice goals. As a physician practicing with a medical affiliate in the Unified network, you will see the benefit of being affiliated with a large, national women's healthcare company while knowing that physician governance and clinical decision making remains the exclusive domain of physicians. We are advocates for the Ob-Gyn medical affiliates in our network, advancing the business of medicine so they can focus solely on the practice of medicine. We help our medical affiliates both innovate and expand, while providing tools, training, support, and additional practice resources. Interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, work instructions, and specifications. Perform machining operations including milling, drilling, tapping, boring, reaming, and turning. Inspect parts using standard and specialized measuring devices to verify conformance to specifications and quality requirements. Troubleshoot machining and tooling issues and make necessary machine adjustments. Understanding of machine shop safety practices, PPE requirements, and safe operating procedures. review_candidates.description: 2 x Board Director Opportunities 1 x Board Director 1 x Chair, Finance & Audit Committee Help shape the future of youth mental health through national Board leadership Bring more than governance credentials - bring purpose, perspective and genuine connection Contribute to a highly respected national organisation, with future Chair succession potential About headspace headspace National Youth Mental Health Foundation is a national organisation dedicated to improving the mental health and wellbeing of young people across Australia. Through its national network, partnerships, advocacy and sector leadership, headspace delivers programs and services to support the mental health and wellbeing of young people and communities. As the national organisation, headspace National operates within a complex operating environment spanning mental health, primary care, community and vocational support services, government, research and diverse communities across metropolitan, regional, rural and remote Australia. The organisation delivers a range of national programs through headspace centres, schools, universities, and online such as eheadspace, telepsychiatry and Work and Study Online. Central to its approach is an understanding that young people’s experiences are shaped by identity, culture, community, geography and broader social circumstances. headspace has many expansion plans over the next three years with 56 new or expanded services and an exciting digital roadmap to reach more young people experiencing a difficult time. The organisation has a deep commitment to the social and emotional wellbeing of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and is guided by a First Nations led cultural strategy and cultural governance. About the Roles headspace is seeking to appoint two experienced Non-Executive Directors who bring strong Board capability and, importantly, a compelling connection to headspace’s purpose, young people and the communities it serves. Both appointments will contribute across the full Board agenda and support longer-term Board renewal and potential Chair succession. Board Director This appointment is an opportunity to bring a distinctive and contemporary voice to the headspace Board. The successful Director will bring genuine connection, insight and credibility with young people and one or more communities or issues shaping their lives today, together with the judgement and governance maturity to contribute across the full Board agenda. That connection may come through lived experience, community leadership or professional experience across areas such as First Nations, LGBTQIA+, multicultural or multifaith communities, young men, disadvantage, homelessness, AOD, family violence, disability, or regional and remote Australia. The Director is not expected to represent any particular community, but to bring authentic, contemporary insight grounded in genuine connection. Chair, Finance & Audit Committee In addition to what is outlined about the Board Director, the Chair, Finance & Audit Committee will bring all of the above plus combine deep financial governance, audit and risk expertise with strong Board judgement, strategic leadership and a genuine connection to headspace’s purpose, young people and the communities it serves. The successful candidate will hold an appropriate professional qualification such as CA/CPA and have demonstrated experience chairing a Finance and/or Audit Committee. These credentials are the entry requirement, not the differentiator: headspace is seeking someone who can contribute across the full Board agenda and bring a compelling reason to be part of the headspace Board. About You Your Board CV matters. But your reason for wanting to join headspace matters more. You will bring the judgement, curiosity and governance maturity expected of a national Director, together with a genuine and contemporary connection to headspace’s purpose, young people and the communities it serves. You will listen well, challenge constructively and contribute beyond your particular area of expertise. Your credibility may come through lived experience, community connection, professional leadership or a combination of these - but it will be authentic and relevant. For the Chair, Finance & Audit Committee, established technical credentials and committee leadership are essential. Across both appointments, we are looking for a clear and compelling answer to: Why headspace? Why this Board? Why now? How to Apply Interested applicants are invited to submit: • A current curriculum vitae • A brief cover letter outlining your interest in the appointment and, importantly, why headspace and why now We encourage applicants to go beyond Board and professional credentials and tell us what connects you to headspace, young people and the communities it serves. We are interested in your motivation, perspective and the contribution you believe you can genuinely make to the Board. Organisational Requirements Successful candidates will be required to hold or obtain: A valid Working with Children Check A current National Police Check Australian Citizenship, Permanent Residency or a valid Australian work permit/visa Hazel Executive & Boards is pleased to be partnering with headspace National Youth Mental Health Foundation on the search and appointment of two Non-Executive Directors: Board Director and Chair, Finance & Audit Committee. All direct and third-party applications will be forwarded to Hazel. Hazel acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the lands on which we live and work and pays respect to Elders past and present. Hazel is committed to equal opportunity and to championing diversity, inclusion, belonging, flexibility and accessibility in all Board and executive appointments. If you require any adjustments throughout the recruitment process, please let us know so we can support you.
